description: Mass gainers and meal replacements are judged as food rather than as supplements, which is why most of the category fails: a product built on maltodextrin and sucralose is not a meal, whatever the tub says.

copy.unit_basis: Per serving. The types on this page do not share one comparison unit, so each product names its own.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your body composition?
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 36 body composition products reaching Kuwait and published none. Publication requires an approved ingredient verdict and an available Kuwait offer. Unresolved declarations and unavailable offers remain in the audit.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Editorial choices among ingredient-admitted references, recorded in the database.

types.name: Mass Gainer
types.purpose: Calories in a shaker, for people who genuinely cannot eat enough.
non_negotiables: Carbohydrate source named — maltodextrin disclosed rather than hidden behind 'carb blend'
Added sugar under 20% of total carbohydrate
Protein at 15% or more of total calories

types.name: Meal Replacement
types.purpose: A complete meal when there is no meal. Judged as food, not as a supplement.
non_negotiables: Fibre present at 3 g or more
No artificial sweeteners, colours or preservatives
Recognisable whole-food ingredients in the first five lines
